K Annamalai Criticizes Film Censorship Board Over 'Toxic' Movie

K Annamalai, former BJP Tamil Nadu chief, has criticized the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) for clearing the film 'Toxic'. He described some scenes in films as "unacceptable" and called for stricter enforcement of the 'A' rating, citing concerns about violent and misogynistic content. Annamalai specifically mentioned the film 'Toxic' in his criticism.
